title: AI-designed protein family binds and senses small molecules, including cortisol
summary: Designed binding proteins for six small-molecule classes, built on a deep-learning NTF2-like fold, were experimentally characterised; one was turned into a cortisol biosensor. Sensitivity reported earlier as nanomolar in the 2023 preprint; the 2026 peer-reviewed version is the source of record. Affinity and sensor figures were not re-checked against the full text.
ai_technology: Deep learning protein design (RFdiffusion-style backbone design with NTF2-like scaffold)
organization: KAIST; University of Washington Institute for Protein Design
